summary: Iteration 7 e-Procurement testing (backend + frontend). Backend pytest: 7/7 passed — Cheapest verified pricelist endpoint returns the seeded Rp 12,500,000 for TEST_Laptop v2 (verified=true) + correct empty shape; Overdue Invoice Reminder cron endpoint (GET /api/cron/overdue-invoice-reminder) returns {ok, run_id, enqueued:true}; Invoice detail exposes audit_trail; POST /invoices/{iid}/pay is idempotent (2nd call returns already_paid:true), pushes 'paid' entry, and 403s for vendor role. Frontend: Tenders admin toolbar works (tender-search, tender-status-filter, tender-groupby, tender-group-* headers), InvoiceDetailSheet Audit Trail timeline renders correctly with PAID badge. CRITICAL: PR builder verified-hint feature is BROKEN — selecting a product in /pr → 'Buat PR' throws a React uncaught runtime error 'verifiedHints is not defined' — the useState for verifiedHints/setVerifiedHints was never declared in PurchaseRequests.jsx, so the entire pr-verified-hint-{i} chip + pr-suggest-verified-{i} badge feature crashes the dialog.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: verifiedHints is not defined. Lines 152, 162, 164, 165, 201 reference verifiedHints/setVerifiedHints but there is NO useState declaration. Reproduce: /pr → Buat PR → +Item → pick any product from dropdown → red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay appears from onValueChange handler. Fix: add `const [verifiedHints, setVerifiedHints] = useState({});` near line 43 (form state block).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend for iteration-7 is 100% green (see /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7_features.py — uses pytest-xdist loadscope per pytest.ini and 60s HTTP timeouts). The only remaining blocker is a missing `useState` for verifiedHints in PurchaseRequests.jsx which crashes the dialog on any product selection. Once E1 adds the state, the pr-verified-hint-{i} click-to-autofill + pr-suggest-verified-{i} badge flow should light up immediately. Do NOT retest iter 5/6 endpoints — those regressions still pass.
rca of the issue: PurchaseRequests.jsx introduces `verifiedHints` and `setVerifiedHints` inside the product-select onValueChange callback (lines 162-165) but never declares them with useState. When the callback fires (product picked), React throws ReferenceError: verifiedHints is not defined and remounts the error overlay. Fix is a single line: `const [verifiedHints, setVerifiedHints] = useState({});` in the same state-declaration block as `form`, `depts`, `products`, etc.
